ItemId.description: The submission id, a generated unique id. A submission with this id is updated.

UserName.description: The user name of the learner. A row whose user is not on the site is reported and skipped.

EnrollmentId.description: The enrollment the work was handed in under.

CourseId.description: The content item id of the course.

CourseworkId.description: The content item id of the coursework.

CourseworkTitle.description: The title of the coursework when the work was handed in.

Current.description: Whether it is the learner's latest submission.

Files.description: The files: FileId, FileName and Size. The files themselves stay in the protected store of the site they were handed in on.

SubmittedUtc.description: When the work was handed in, in UTC.

DueUtc.description: The due date of the coursework when the work was handed in, in UTC; the late flag and penalty are worked out from it.

Late.description: Whether it came after the due date.

MaxPoints.description: The points the work was graded out of.

RubricId.description: The content item id of the rubric it was graded against.

RubricChoices.description: The level id chosen for each rubric criterion id.

GraderUserName.description: The user name of the grader.

GradedUtc.description: When it was graded, in UTC.

ReturnedByUserName.description: The user name of the person who returned it.

ReturnedUtc.description: When it was returned, in UTC.

History.description: The earlier grades: Score, Points, MaxPoints, RubricChoices, Feedback, GraderUserName, GradedUtc, ReplacedByUserName, ReplacedUtc, Reason.

Submissions.description: The submissions to create, or update by id.
